_about: Customer-style queries for the ADPF FAQ workbook (sheet 'FAQs'), written the way customers type to the contact centre — Emirati colloquial and lay MSA, not the FAQ's official wording. 'gold' lists every Excel row number that answers the query (near-duplicate FAQs share a query). 'unanswerable' are in-domain questions no FAQ answers. Written 2026-10-16 against the 142-row version.
